name: ev3-cockpit
description: VS Code extension for EV3 brick discovery, connection, and monitoring

ev3-cockpit.mockBricks.markdownDescription: Show simulated bricks, for development. Left unset, they appear only while the extension runs from source (F5) and never in an installed build. Takes effect after reloading the window.

enumDescriptions: Extensions using the cockpit write, delete and run only in the brick's projects folder (/home/root/lms2012/prjs) and on its SD card (/media/card); they read everywhere.
Extensions using the cockpit may change any file on the brick and run shell commands on it.
ev3-cockpit.accessMode.markdownDescription: What other extensions may do on a brick through the cockpit. **safe** keeps them to the user areas; **full** opens the whole brick, shell included.

ev3-cockpit.telemetry.staleFactor.markdownDescription: A telemetry value counts as **stale** when no newer reading has come for this many of its own reading intervals (a brick that stalls, a reading that keeps failing). A value also turns stale at once when its brick stops being read.

ev3-cockpit.telemetry.staleTimeoutMs.markdownDescription: How long a **stale** telemetry value is still shown, marked as stale, before it is dropped, in milliseconds. A brick that disconnects drops its values at once.

ev3-cockpit.telemetry.throttle.enabled.markdownDescription: Slow a brick's telemetry down while the brick answers slowly (a running Wi-Fi stack, its port screen open, a busy link), and speed it back up when it recovers. Each brick on its own.

ev3-cockpit.telemetry.throttle.windowSiz.markdownDescription: How many telemetry frames make one window. At the end of each window the slowest 5 % of its round trips (p95) decides whether the telemetry slows down.

ev3-cockpit.telemetry.throttle.tailFacto.markdownDescription: A window's p95 round trip may be this many times the link's usual round trip (USB 10 ms, TCP 60 ms, Bluetooth 130 ms) before the telemetry slows down.

ev3-cockpit.telemetry.throttle.step.markdownDescription: How much one step slows the telemetry tick down, or speeds it back up.

ev3-cockpit.telemetry.throttle.maxSlowdo.markdownDescription: The most the telemetry tick is slowed, as a multiple of its planned tick.

ev3-cockpit.telemetry.throttle.calmWindo.markdownDescription: How many windows in a row must stay within the limit before the telemetry speeds up a step.

scripts.test:ci: npm run compile && npm run lint && npm run test:unit && npm run test:host
scripts.test:ci:release: npm run compile && npm run lint && npm run test:unit && npm run test:host && npm run package
